results.title: Frankenstein Fragment
results.overview: Norbert Pfaffenbichler, master of the darkest avant-garde cinema, is also a veritable film archaeologist. No wonder, then, that his excavations of forgotten celluloid legacies unearthed a sensation: fragments of the very first film adaptation of Mary Shelley’s Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, shot in Germany in 1922 and long believed to be lost, including test footage and outtakes. Pfaffenbichler and his team set about shaping this material of incredible historical value into a version that comes as close as possible to the original concept of its unknown filmmaker. Now, SLASH is unbelievably proud to present the resurrection of this lost film to the public for the very first time. (Markus Keuschnigg)

results.title: Red Velvet
results.overview: After the death of her father, a young woman takes over the family baking business. One day, a pretty stranger visits her cupcake stall, and she begins to believe that love is something she must have. Something she must be consumed by.

results.title: Hazirun
results.overview: In the early morning following a night shaken by citywide protests, Ali, a man in his twenties, is awakened by police sirens and forced to act as a “Hazirun” during a search of a neighboring apartment. Drawn into the process with no ability to intervene-valued only for his presence, signature, and silence-Ali becomes trapped in a gray zone between law, authority, and conscience, as events spiral out of control and irreversibly fracture his everyday life.

results.title: StraightUpMagic: 10 Years of StraightupG
results.overview: 5 Years after Mason and Greg snuck into Grants room to try and reboot StraightupG, Grant and Brad are finally ready to reunite and give the fans what they want… but why were they apart? What’s next for StraightupG? And will the memories of 10 years of an incredible friendship, full of unbelievable accomplishments be able to heal the broken bonds of love. Find out as they celebrate 10 years of StraightupG with the iconic cast and crew of the 2019 classic “The StraightUpG Movie”. Hosted by Dusty B and Colton themselves, this is one celebration you won’t want to miss.

results.title: Direction les Champs
results.overview: This summer, the Tour de France is finally coming by the tiny village of Laventour. For our 8-years-old Sophie, there’s no way her big brother Benoît can miss it. Once the village’s cycling champion, he hasn’t spoken, left his room or shown any interest for the outside world for months. But Sophie isn’t giving up that easily : the peloton is coming… and so are they!

results.title: Renato Freitas: Born to Disturb
results.overview: The film shows how Renato Freitas breaks into the spaces of institutional power, going head-to-head with corrupt political bosses and fighting radically for the lives of all people.  We go behind the scenes of these clashes, the persecution, and the resistance strategies of one of us in power.
